title: Remote Conveyancing Paralegal
company: LEGAL TALENT PARTNERS LIMITED - Agency - Permanent
description:
Remote Conveyancing Paralegal

£30,000-40,000

Quality. Technology. Flexibility. A Better Way to Do Conveyancing.

We're partnering with a fast-growing, forward-thinking residential conveyancing firm that is using technology, smarter processes and a collaborative team structure to change the way property law is delivered.

The firm is built around a simple idea: conveyancing should be simpler, clearer and faster - for clients and the people delivering it.

If you're an experienced conveyancing paralegal looking for greater autonomy, better technology, a sustainable workload and the flexibility of a fully remote role, this could be an excellent next move.

Why This Role Stands Out

This is not a traditional conveyancing environment where paralegals are left to manage overwhelming caseloads with little support.

You'll work within small, collaborative teams, with regular check-ins, structured 1-to-1s, feedback and personalised training.

The firm takes a quality over quantity approach to workload, maintaining sustainable caseloads and giving teams capacity to deal with peaks without compromising client service.

You'll benefit from:
- Sustainable caseloads and a strong focus on work-life balance
- Small, collaborative teams
- Regular support, feedback and development
- Bespoke technology designed around legal teams
- A culture where asking for help is encouraged
- The opportunity to influence how technology and processes develop
- Fully remote working with genuine flexibility

The result? A more manageable workload, better support and the freedom to focus on delivering excellent conveyancing rather than simply processing as many files as possible.

The Role

As a Conveyancing Paralegal, you'll be an integral part of a residential conveyancing team, working alongside lawyers and other paralegals to deliver an excellent client service.

You'll work across freehold and leasehold sales, purchases and remortgages, taking ownership of your matters while working collaboratively with the wider team.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Progressing residential sales, purchases and remortgages
- Handling freehold sales with minimal supervision
- Managing most leasehold sale enquiries with minimal supervision
- Managing most freehold purchase enquiries with minimal supervision
- Liaising with clients, solicitors, estate agents and other third parties
- Proactively identifying issues and keeping transactions moving
- Reviewing and responding to enquiries
- Maintaining clear, jargon-free communication
- Using the firm's technology to manage your caseload efficiently
- Identifying and resolving potential issues before they become blockers
- Providing feedback to improve systems and processes

The firm's technology has been developed specifically around its conveyancing process, and legal professionals are encouraged to provide feedback on the tools they use every day.

About you

You'll ideally have:
- Strong experience in residential conveyancing
- Experience handling freehold sales with limited supervision
- Experience dealing with leasehold sale enquiries
- Experience dealing with freehold purchase enquiries
- Confidence communicating with clients and third parties
- A proactive approach to progressing transactions
- Strong organisation and attention to detail
- Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
- Confidence working independently in a remote environment
- An interest in using technology to improve legal work

You don't need to be qualified. This role is suited to an experienced paralegal with strong technical conveyancing skills who is ready to take greater ownership of their work.

Although fully remote, you won't be left alone with a laptop and a pile of files. Regular team check-ins, 1-to-1s and ongoing feedback are built into the firm's approach.

The Culture:

This is a firm deliberately doing things differently.

Rather than chasing maximum utilisation, it takes a sustainable approach to workload, helping teams maintain consistent service levels while giving people room to deal with the unexpected.

Its technology helps allocate work, streamline processes and keep teams informed, while its remote-working model is built around communication, supervision, feedback and development.

There's also a strong culture of transparency and continuous improvement. People are encouraged to share ideas, challenge processes and help shape the future of the business.

The Package
- £30,000-£40,000 depending on experience
- Fully remote - work from anywhere in the UK
- Flexible working hours
- 25 days' holiday + 3 days at Christmas + Bank Holidays
- Full home-working setup and equipment provided
- Comprehensive private healthcare
- Free access to Spill mental health and wellbeing support
- Company pension scheme
- Enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption leave
- Growth Shares, giving employees an opportunity to share in the long-term success of the business
- Fully paid-for annual company weekend
- Structured development and genuine progression opportunities

The firm's flexible approach is a key part of its culture, with many employees working flexible hours or part-time. The focus is on creating working patterns that work for both the individual and the wider team.

If you're an experienced conveyancing paralegal looking for a genuinely modern, supportive and flexible place to build your career, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Cash Allocation Administrator
description:
Cash Allocation Administrator

Are you a seeking a new opportunity?

We are seeking an enthusiastic and engaged individual to join the finance team to focus on cash allocation administration.

As part of this role you will be performing daily reconciliation and allocation of incoming cash using customer remittances for commercial accounts. Contacting customers via email and phone when remittances are missing or unclear, ensuring accurate allocation.

Join our client's team at The Point, Warwick Business Park and enjoy:

Fixed Term - 01/10/26 - 31/03/27 with potential for extension.

Competitive Pay: Earn £13.45 per hour, 37.5 hours per week, overtime rates of £20.18 per hour.
Shifts Monday to Friday - (minus 1 hour unpaid break)
Perks: Free on-site parking, provided PPE, comprehensive training.

Cash Allocation - Key Responsibilities
- Daily reconciliation and allocation of incoming cash using customer remittances for commercial accounts.
- Contacting customers via email and phone when remittances are missing or unclear, ensuring accurate allocation.
- Recording all activity in Salesforce, including attempts to obtain remittances and any issues affecting allocation.
- Reversing incorrect allocations and reallocating funds accurately when errors are identified.
- Identifying anomalies in remittances and proactively contacting customers to clarify or resolve discrepancies

Skills & Competencies
- Strong computer literacy and confidence using finance systems.
- Intermediate Excel skills (e.g., lookups, pivot tables, data manipulation).
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Clear and professional communication with internal teams and external customers.
- Good numerical ability and comfort working with financial data.
- Ability to maintain focus and accuracy when performing repetitive tasks.
- Experienced in using IT software such as SAP, OnBase, Microsoft outlook, Microsoft excel, salesforce.
- Successful candidates require a DBS check.

title: HR Administrator
description:
From Pipelines to Possibilities - Make Your Mark with Cadent

We are looking for organised, customer-focused, and detail-driven individuals to join Cadent as a People Services Administrator within the HR team.

As a People Services Administrator, you will provide key administrative support across a wide range of HR activities, acting as a first point of contact for employee queries and ensuring a high-quality, efficient service. You will play an important role in maintaining accurate HR records, supporting HR processes, and delivering excellent customer service to both internal and external stakeholders.

This is a fantastic opportunity to gain experience within HR while contributing to the smooth running of a vital support function in one of the UK's leading energy networks.

How Cadent Powers Britain

Cadent is shaping the future of UK energy. With a clear roadmap to support the UK government's net zero targets by 2050, Cadent is driving innovation and creating a cleaner, greener future for over 11 million customers. Join Cadent and be part of something big.

How You'll Make an Impact

In this role, you'll support the delivery of HR services by providing high-quality administrative and customer support. Your responsibilities will include:
- Acting as the first point of contact for HR queries via phone, email, and other channels
- Providing advice and guidance or signposting queries to the appropriate teams
- Supporting HR processes including onboarding, absence management, and employee records
- Maintaining accurate HR systems, databases, and employee files
- Preparing and issuing documentation such as contracts, letters, and forms
- Supporting probation reviews, exit processes, and general HR administration
- Managing shared inboxes and ensuring responses meet SLAs
- Building strong relationships with stakeholders across the business
- Ensuring all tasks are completed in line with Cadent policies and procedures
- Contributing to continuous improvement and service excellence

How We'll Know You're the Right Fit

We're looking for someone who is organised, proactive, and customer-focused. You'll ideally demonstrate:
- Working towards CIPD L3 or equivalent
- Experience in an administrative or customer service role
- Strong organisational skills and ability to prioritise workload
- Excellent communication skills (written and verbal)
- High attention to detail and accuracy
- Confidence working with data and systems
- Good knowledge of Microsoft Office
- A collaborative approach and ability to build strong working relationships
- An interest in HR (CIPD or similar is desirable but not essential)
- A proactive mindset and willingness to learn

How It All Comes Together
- Pay rate: £13.53 per hour (PAYE, paid weekly)
- Assignment duration: 26/02/2027
- Start date: ASAP
- Location: Pilot Way, Ansty Park, Coventry, West Midlands, CV7 9 JU
- Working pattern: Hybrid 2 days in the office, 3 days WFH, Monday to Friday, 37 hours per week (between 8am - 5pm)

How This Role Benefits You

Don't meet every single requirement listed? Cadent would still love to hear from you.

Cadent Gas values understanding, learning, and celebrating differences. They are an equitable and diverse employer, fostering an inclusive and accessible working environment for all.
- Recognised Disability Confident employer
- Inclusive employee communities
- Full training and on-the-job support
- Opportunity to gain HR experience within a leading UK organisation
- Free onsite parking
- Modern office facilities

How to Take the Next Step

If you're interested, please apply today with your updated CV.

A member of the Reed team will be in touch to guide you through the next steps, including a telephone interview, client interview, and pre-employment checks.

Be part of something big. Help keep Britain connected.

description:
Accounts Assistant

Location: Rugby / DIRFT
Full-time 40 hours per week
Permanent

Macildowie are delighted to be partnering with a growing, privately owned property and development business to recruit an Accounts Assistant into their finance team.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys a varied, hands-on finance role and wants to join an energetic, fast-moving and down-to-earth business.

Working closely with the Financial Controllers and wider finance team, you'll take responsibility for a broad range of transactional accounting duties across several group companies. The role offers plenty of variety, covering both purchase and sales ledger activity alongside credit control, cashbooks, reconciliations and general finance support.

The Role

Your responsibilities will include:
- Setting up and maintaining customer accounts and producing sales invoices
- Investigating and resolving customer queries
- Reviewing customer accounts and chasing outstanding debts
- Processing purchase invoices and credit card receipts
- Reconciling supplier statements
- Managing multiple purchase ledger inboxes and responding to invoice queries
- Setting up cashbook payments
- Maintaining cashbooks and completing weekly bank reconciliations
- Ensuring invoices receive the correct VAT and CIS treatment
- Producing ad hoc project spend reports
- Filing and maintaining finance documentation
- Supporting the year-end audit process
- Providing wider administrative and finance support as required

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is practical, enthusiastic and comfortable rolling their sleeves up as part of a close-knit team.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience within an accounts or transactional finance role
- Strong attention to detail
- Good communication and relationship-building skills
- The ability to manage your own workload and work to deadlines
- Confidence balancing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
- A proactive, flexible and resilient approach
- Intermediate Excel skills

Experience using COINS, Sage 50 and/or Xero would be advantageous, although it isn't essential.

The business is also forward-thinking in its approach to technology, so an interest in using AI tools such as ChatGPT to improve or automate accounting processes would be particularly welcome.

Why Apply?

This is an opportunity to join a growing organisation where you'll be part of a small, dedicated team and have exposure to a genuinely varied range of finance activities.

If you're an Accounts Assistant looking for a broad role within a fast-paced, personable and hands-on environment, we'd love to hear from you.

Working as part of a supportive accounts team and reporting into the Head of Accounts, you'll play an important role in the day-to-day running of the finance function.

- Supporting the wider accounts team with general finance and administrative duties

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is numerate, accurate and comfortable working with financial information.

Previous experience within an accounts, finance or transactional finance environment would be highly advantageous. Experience within professional services would also be beneficial, although isn't essential.

You'll also need to be:
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail
- Comfortable working independently with minimal supervision
- Able to manage competing priorities and busier periods
- Confident communicating with colleagues and external contacts
- Approachable, dependable and a strong team player
- Discreet when handling confidential financial information

What's on Offer?

This is an excellent opportunity to join an established organisation in a varied Accounts Assistant role with plenty of involvement across the day-to-day finance function.

Salary: Up to £30,000
Working arrangement: Fully office based
Employment: Permanent, full time

title: Activities & Coaching Operations Coordinator
company: Riding for the Disabled Association (RDA) - Agency - Permanent
description:
Activities and Coaching Operations Coordinator

At Riding for the Disabled Association (RDA), we enrich lives through the unique bond between people and horses. Each year, we support over 39,000 disabled children and adults through activities including riding, carriage driving, and equine assisted programmes such as Quiet Corners and Tea with a Pony. We are pioneers in the therapeutic use of horses, leaders in disability sport, and the only major UK charity focused specifically on the health and wellbeing benefits of bringing people and horses together.

We welcome people of all ages and abilities, including those with physical and learning disabilities, sensory impairments, long-term health conditions, and neurodiversity. With 24% of the UK population classified as disabled, we make a lasting impact through the therapeutic power of horses.

We are now looking for an Activities and Coaching Operations Coordinator to join the team at our national office in Warwickshire and help us to continue our work.

Role Purpose

To support the coordination, development, and effective delivery of RDA participants' activities, ensuring objectives are achieved in line with the charity's strategic priorities. The postholder will provide coordination, administrative and compliance support, contributing to the safe, consistent and effective delivery of participant activities and associated coaching processes. RDA activities include riding, carriage driving, vaulting and other specialist or emerging activities that support participant development, achievement and wellbeing.

Specific Responsibilities

Activities Support & Coordination
- Assist with the coordination of specialist activities including carriage driving, vaulting and other developing activity areas.
- Act as a first point of response for activity-related enquiries from RDA Groups, volunteers and coaches.
- Develop, maintain and review activity related guidance, resources, forms and information.
- Support activity advisory groups and associated projects, including meeting administration, actions and follow-up as required.
- Provide operational and administrative support to the wider Coaching and Equine Team to facilitate effective service delivery

Activity Compliance & Coaching Support
- Support the implementation and communication of activity standards, guidance, and recommendations.
- Support the collection and maintenance of information relating to activity-specific concerns, actions and follow-up requirements.
- Support with quality assurance and information gathering processes relating to activities and coaching.
- Provide support and assistance with coaching administration, including training and assessment, coaching pathway and the maintenance of forms, guidance and resources.

Team Administration & Operational Support
- Planning and facilitation of internal and external meetings, including agenda distribution, minute taking and follow-up actions as required.
- Processing and recording of paperwork relating to activities and coaching.
- Assist with the development, maintenance and continuous improvement of online resources, learning materials and information, working closely with colleagues to ensure content remains accurate, accessible and up to date.
- Support budget administration, including processing relevant expenses and monitoring expenditure as required.
- Assist with event administration and the delivery of activities, training and other departmental events.
- Support colleagues with projects and initiatives across the Coaching and Equine team as required.

Stakeholder Support
- Provision of advice and guidance to volunteers, coaches and member groups in relation to activities and associated processes.
- Build and maintain positive working relationships with activity volunteers, coaches, advisory groups and relevant external stakeholders.
- Gather feedback from activity volunteers, coaches, member groups and the wider RDA network, identifying recurring themes, opportunities and concerns, escalating issues where appropriate, and providing insight to support the Head of Coaching and Equine and wider team.
- Support effective communication of activity and coaching information across the RDA network.

General
- Undertake such other duties as the line manager shall from time to time determine.
- Demonstrate the values and cultural aspirations of RDA in all work.
- Ensure due consideration is always given to our charitable aims and objectives and that this is demonstrated in all activities.
- Attend and support the National Championships and other key events as required, including planning and preparation activities in advance of events and operational support during delivery.

Person Specification

Essential
- Experience of coordinating activities, events, training, projects or programmes, with the ability to prioritise competing demands.
- Excellent organisational and administrative skills, with accuracy and attention to detail.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience of providing advice, guidance or customer support in a professional environment
- Ability to build and maintain effective working relationships with colleagues, volunteers and stakeholders.
- Understanding of, and ability to work effectively within, a volunteer-led environment.
- Empathy with the aims and values of RDA.
- Ability to use initiative, work independently and contribute effectively as part of a team.
- Working understanding of inclusion, equality, safeguarding and relevant good practice.
- Good digital literacy, including experience of Microsoft Office and other digital systems.

Desirable
- Knowledge or experience of equestrian sport, coaching or equine-related environments.
- Knowledge or experience of RDA and its activities.
- Understanding of carriage driving and its operational requirements.
- Experience of working within a charity or membership organisation.
- Experience of compliance, quality assurance or operational processes

title: Admin Assistant
description: Join Our OpCourage Veterans Mental Health Team! Exciting opportunity for an enthusiastic Administrator to join our Veterans Mental Health Team, supporting veterans and their families across the West Midlands. As one of the first points of contact for many of the veterans accessing our service, you will play a really important role in making sure they receive a warm, professional and supportive experience from the very first contact. Working alongside our dedicated team of clinicians, your role will include a range of general administrative duties, including answering calls and emails, managing appointments, maintaining accurate records, supporting clinical teams, data entry and helping the service run smoothly day to day. But this role is about much more than administration -- you'll be part of a team that genuinely cares about the work we do and the veterans we support. We are a passionate, hard-working and supportive team who take our work seriously... but we also believe in having great fun along the way! If you're organised, approachable, compassionate and enjoy working as part of a team, we'd love to hear from you. Come and join us and be part of something that makes a real difference to the lives of veterans and their families. To provide efficient secretarial and administrative support to the clinical team, adhering to procedures and processes within service timescales, whilst operating within a busy and demanding environment. Work effectively as a team member. Provide an administrative service across both pathways of the service, (urgent and non-urgent) including: word-processing, drafting and producing for example meeting notes, reports, letters and business documents from either audio or copy sources. Undertake general office duties as required including filing, photocopying, collating and distributing information, receipt and distribution of incoming and outgoing mail. Operate and maintain a robust, accurate and secure filing system that is easily accessible by all staff. Maintain spread sheets and databases including the production of regular information reports Linking in with NHS colleagues within our partnership including BSMHFT and LPFT and our Military Charity partners including Walking with the Wounded and The Ripple Pond. Be responsible for organising and servicing meetings / events as required, including room bookings, taking accurate notes, transcription and circulation as appropriate Procurement - order stationery, clinical supplies and equipment stock Use own initiative to meet tight deadlines Provide flexible administrative and clerical cover as required. This will involve working occasionally in both pathways, to provide cross cover arrangements.

title: Receptionist
description: PLEASE NOTE THE HOURS REQUIRED FOR THIS ROLE ARE 13:30 - 18:30 Monday to Friday. We are seeking a professional and friendly Receptionist to join our team. The ideal candidate will be the first point of contact for our patients and visitors, providing exceptional customer service while managing various tasks. This role is essential in ensuring the smooth operation of our GP Practice. Maintaining and monitoring the Practice appointments system Processing personal requests for appointments, visits and telephone consultations and ensuring callers are directed to the appropriate healthcare professional. Processing and distributing incoming and outgoing mail. Explaining practice arrangements and formal requirements to new patients and those seeking temporary cover and ensure procedures are completed. Receiving and making telephone calls as required. Divert calls and take messages, ensuring accuracy of detail and prompt appropriate delivery. Processing prescriptions in accordance with practice guidelines Computer data entry/data allocation and collation; processing and recording information in accordance with Practice procedures. Initiating contact with and responding to requests from patients, other team members and associated healthcare agencies and providers Advise patients of relevant charges for private (non-General Medical Services), accept payment and issue receipts. Clearing and re-stocking consulting rooms as required. Providing administrative support to the Practice as required, including filing, photocopying and scanning. Keeping the reception area, noticeboards, and leaflet dispensers tidy and free from obstructions and clutter Providing cover for reception / administrative colleagues during absence due to holiday or sick leave. Maintaining and monitoring the practice appointment system Process personal, telephone and e-requests for appointments. Answer incoming phone calls, transferring calls or dealing with the callers request appropriately. Signpost patients to the correct service. Input data into the patients healthcare records, as necessary. Direct requests for information i.e. SAR, insurance / solicitors letters, and DVLA forms to the administrative team Support in the management of repeat prescriptions, ensuring they are processed accurately and efficiently. Process repeat prescription requests received by any means of communication in accordance with practice protocol. Ensure all prescription requests are processed and are ready for collection within the required and expected timeframe. Generate requests for medication on behalf of the patient for non-repeat items. Discuss with patients their requirements, encouraging patients to order only what they require. Act upon compliance issues, liaising with the appropriate clinician. Ensure medication reviews are arranged by maintaining an accurate recall system. Effectively liaise with external services, i.e., district nurses, to ensure medicaments are arranged for housebound patients. Initiate contact with and respond to, requests from patients, team members, and external agencies. Manage all queries as necessary in an efficient manner. Act as a chaperone as required. Be aware of your duties and responsibilities regarding current legislation and adhere to practice policies and procedures on Safeguarding Adults and Safeguarding Children Attend a formal appraisal with their manager at least every 12 months. Once a performance/training objective has been set, progress will be reviewed on a regular basis so that new objectives can be agreed. Undertake all mandatory training and induction programmes deemed suitable by the Practice Manager / Partners. Be an integral part of the general practice team. Support all clinical staff with general tasks as requested. Maintain a clean, tidy, effective working area at all times. Providing administrative support to the Practice as required, including filing, photocopying, scanning, culling of notes. Support reception staff, providing cover during staff absences. Scanning of patient related documentation and attaching scanned documents to patients healthcare records Complete opening and closing procedures in accordance with the duty rota. Support administrative staff, providing cover during staff absences. Participate in local initiatives to enhance service delivery and patient care. Support the Operations Manager in reviewing and updating the Prescribing Policy and SOPs Any other duties commensurate with this position
